Vinclozolin in an androgen receptor reporter gene assay

Source: R/data.R
vinclozolin.Rd

Luminescence of Chinese hamster ovary cells exposed to concentrations of vinclozolin for 22 hours; the experiment was repeated six times on different days.

Usage

vinclozolin

Format

A data frame with 53 rows and 3 variables:

exper

experiment (day), a factor with 6 levels

conc

concentration of vinclozolin

effect

luminescence

Source

Nellemann, C., Dalgaard, M., Lam, H. R. and Vinggaard, A. M. (2003) The combined effects of vinclozolin and procymidone do not deviate from expected additivity in vitro and in vivo. Toxicological Sciences, 71, 251–262; from the package drcData.

Examples

vmod <- drmTMB(effect ~ conc, data = vinclozolin, model = "loglogistic",
               rform = b1 + b2 ~ 1 | exper, start = c(b5 = 0), fix = c(b5 = TRUE),
               lower = c(0, 0, -Inf, 0, -Inf))  # lower bounds of b1-b5
# ED50 of the population curve, with profile likelihood interval
confint(ed(vmod, 50, random = FALSE))
#> Computing profile confidence intervals ...
#>             2.5 %    97.5 %
#> 50:lf1 0.03225858 0.0922736
